response.sql: WITH overall_stats AS (SELECT AVG(modindex) as overall_avg FROM signals WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL), status_stats AS (SELECT COALESCE(rfistat, 'No Status') as status, AVG(modindex) as status_avg FROM signals WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL GROUP BY COALESCE(rfistat, 'No Status')), filtered_stats AS (SELECT ss.status, ss.status_avg, os.overall_avg FROM status_stats ss CROSS JOIN overall_stats os WHERE ss.status_avg > os.overall_avg), qualifying_mean AS (SELECT AVG(status_avg) as mean_of_qualifying FROM filtered_stats) SELECT fs.status, fs.status_avg, fs.status_avg - fs.overall_avg as above_average, fs.status_avg - qm.mean_of_qualifying as differs_from_mean FROM filtered_stats fs CROSS JOIN qualifying_mean qm ORDER BY fs.status_avg DESC
